name: Kuyou Sarasa
source:
A third-year student, one year older than the protagonist.
She is in Class 3-F.

She is the student council president at The Academy and also serves as the dormitory supervisor.
She is beautiful, well-behaved, and academically gifted.
Not only is she adept at sports, but as the daughter of a wealthy family, she is simply flawless.

While she commands the respect of the entire school due to her flawless reputation, her aloof, cool gaze and the unsettling rumors that follow her have led others to keep their distance, making her a solitary figure.
However, once she steps away from the student council, she reveals a different side to the protagonist alone—that of the “Maou’s Servant.”
The protagonist finds himself tormented every night by her stimulating, all-out devotion, as she swears absolute loyalty to the Maou…
